edges: Placebo effects may involve the modulation of pain impulses.
Placebo effects are a powerful part of all medical care, including pain management.
The effectiveness of the placebo effect is influenced by patient belief.
Placebo analgesia is a form of pain relief.
Branding can influence the effectiveness of the placebo effect.
The placebo effect is associated with pain relief.
The placebo effect is mediated by natural opiates.
Physician attitude can affect the placebo effect.
